subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress transient tool error warnings

question: Should normal chat support a final-only or internal-only tool-error delivery mode beyond the existing `messages.suppressToolErrors` full suppression flag?
rationale: Current code intentionally preserves visible warnings for success-looking mutating failures, while the issue asks to suppress that class for hosted and group-chat UX; code inspection cannot choose the safety versus cleanliness policy safely.

options.title: Add final-only policy
options.body: Introduce a typed message delivery policy that suppresses post-success transient warnings while still surfacing unresolved or explicitly failed final turns.

options.title: Document full suppression only
options.body: Treat `messages.suppressToolErrors` as the supported operator contract and state that final-only suppression is not currently planned.

options.title: Keep current safety default
options.body: Leave success-looking mutating failures visible by default and require operators to opt into any broader suppression mode explicitly.

recommendation.title: Add final-only policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed message delivery policy that suppresses post-success transient warnings while still surfacing unresolved or explicitly failed final turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The related warning-leak fix and discussion make vincentkoc the strongest available routing candidate for the remaining product-policy choice.
